settings.title: A cart and a borrowed grinder
settings.text: Saturdays at the harbour market: one brewer, two origins and a queue that kept getting longer.

settings.title: Our first bar
settings.text: Twelve seats on Kiln Street, a slow bar for filter and a wall of beans you could smell from the pavement.

settings.title: A roastery of our own
settings.text: A 15 kg drum in an old boat shed. We started buying direct and publishing every price we pay.

settings.title: Tea joins the bar
settings.text: Whole-leaf teas from three gardens, whisked matcha and the same small-batch care as the coffee.

settings.title: We visit every farm
settings.text: Someone from the roastery stands on every farm we buy from, at least once every two harvests.

settings.title: We pay for the cup
settings.text: Prices are set by cup score, not the commodity market, and agreed before the harvest starts.

settings.title: We publish every price
settings.text: What we paid, to whom and for how much: every lot, every year, in one open report.

settings.name: Maren Oduya
settings.note: Trains every new barista and still pulls the first shot each morning.

settings.name: Tomas Reyhill
settings.note: Writes every profile and cups each batch before it is bagged.

settings.name: Ines Varga
settings.note: Spends harvest season on the farms and sets the prices we publish.

settings.name: Kofi Lindqvist
settings.note: Built the tea list from three gardens and hosts the Sunday tastings.

settings.name: Ada Nakamura
settings.note: Looks after the forty cafés that pour our coffee.

settings.name: Sol Batista
settings.note: Packs every Tuesday order by hand and writes the roast date on each bag.
